features: Longest natural unbroken sea beach in the world (120 km), Laboni Beach, Sugandha, Inani coral beach, Marine Drive.
how_to_reach: Air via Cox's Bazar Airport (CXB), Train (Cox's Bazar Exp), AC Coaches (Green Line, Hanif, Desh).

features: Only coral island of Bangladesh, crystal turquoise waters, live coral colonies, Chera Dwip, scuba diving.
how_to_reach: Tourist ships from Teknaf / Cox's Bazar (Keari Sindbad, Bay One).

features: 1,800 ft above sea level, sea of clouds, Konglak Para, Lusai and Tripura ethnic tribal settlements, Helipad view.
best_season: Year-round (Monsoon for clouds, Winter for pleasant hiking)
how_to_reach: Bus to Khagrachhari, then Chander Gari with military convoy security.

features: Lush rolling tea estates, Lawachara National Park, seven-layer tea at Nilkantha, Madhabpur Lake.
how_to_reach: Direct train from Dhaka (Parabat, Jayantika, Upaban) or Sylhet highway buses.

features: Rare geographical location where both sunrise and sunset can be viewed unobstructed over the Bay of Bengal, Rakhine villages.
how_to_reach: Direct highway drive via Padma & Payra Bridges (approx 5-6 hours from Dhaka).

features: Vast freshwater ecosystem, migratory birds, crystal clear water against the backdrop of Meghalaya hills, luxury houseboats.
best_season: Monsoon (July - September) for houseboats, Winter for migratory birds
how_to_reach: Bus to Sunamganj, then Tahirpur ghat to board houseboats.
